Use a hybrid movement-first model. Do NOT create a separate master record for every equipment swap when the movement and form are essentially the same.
Master movement = Biceps Curl. Compatible Equipment = Dumbbell; Barbell; EZ-Bar; Cable; Machine; Bands. The workout instance stores which equipment the user actually used.

A user can swap Cable → Dumbbell → Barbell without replacing the exercise, losing history, or confusing the AI. Progress can still be filtered by equipment because equipment is stored on each performed exercise/workout instance.
When to keep a separate exercise

Create a separate record when setup, biomechanics, ROM, intent, or coaching cues meaningfully change. Hammer Curl, Preacher Curl, Incline Curl, and Concentration Curl remain separate from Biceps Curl.
Bench Press and Incline Press remain separate. Back Squat and Front Squat remain separate. Romanian Deadlift and conventional Deadlift remain separate.
